parameters.help_en: The time to perform the backup. The time is in the HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ format (UTC). The time range is limited to 1 hour
parameters.help_zh: 执行备份的时间，格式为HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 时间范围限制为1小时
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot backup type. Valid values:

Flash: Backup within seconds.
Standard: Standard backup (default value)
parameters.help_zh:
快照备份类型，取值说明：

Flash：秒级备份。
Standard：常规备份（默认值）
parameters.name: snapshot_backup_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup data retention policy.

0: All backup sets of the instance are immediately deleted when the instance is released.
1: The last backup set is retained with long-term retention (LTR) when the instance is released.
2: All backup sets are retained with long-term retention (LTR) when the instance is released
parameters.help_zh:
备份保留策略。

0：实例释放时立即删除该实例的所有备份集
1：实例释放时会长期保留最后一个备份集
2：实例释放时会长期保留所有备份集
parameters.name: backup_retention_policy_on_cluster_deletion

fields.help_en:
The action type. Valid values:
CREATE: Create.
UPDATE: Update.
DELETE: Delete. In this case, only PolicyId is required for other parameters
fields.help_zh:
处置动作。取值：
CREATE：新增
UPDATE：修改
DELETE：删除，此时，其他参数只需要传入PolicyId
fields.name: action_type

fields.help_en:
The scheduling type of the advanced policy. Valid values:
dayOfWeek: scheduled by week.
dayOfMonth: scheduled by month.
dayOfYear: scheduled by year.
backupInterval: scheduled at fixed intervals (high-frequency backup). 


Multiple high-frequency backup policies are not supported.
Multiple geo-redundancy backup policies are not supported, and geo-redundancy backup policies support only dayOfWeek.

<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to DELETE.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
高级策略调度类型，取值如下：
dayOfWeek：按周调度
dayOfMonth：按月调度
dayOfYear：按年调度
backupInterval：固定间隔调度  （高频备份） 


不支持多条高频备份策略。
不支持多条异地备份，且异地备份策略只支持dayOfWeek

<notice>ActionType!=delete时必填></notice>
fields.name: backup_policy

fields.help_en:
The destination region of the backup policy.
<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to DELETE.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
备份策略目标地域。
<notice>ActionType!=delete时必填></notice>
fields.name: dest_region

fields.help_en:
The destination type of the backup policy.
 
level1: same-region backup. 
level2Cross: cross-region backup.
<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to DELETE.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
备份策略目标类型。
 
level1 ：同地域备份 
level2Cross：跨地域备份
<notice>ActionType!=delete时必填></notice>
fields.name: dest_type

fields.help_en:
The backup policy ID.

<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to CREATE.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
备份策略 ID。


<notice>当ActionType!=CREATE时必填。></notice>
fields.name: policy_id

fields.help_en:
The backup cycle.
If BackupPolicy is set to dayOfWeek: 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 indicates Monday through Sunday. At least 2 backups per week are required.
If BackupPolicy is set to dayOfMonth: 1,3,-1 indicates the 1st, 3rd, and last day of each month. -1 indicates the last day of each month.
If BackupPolicy is set to dayOfYear: 01-07 indicates January 7. Only one day can be selected.
If BackupPolicy is set to backupInterval: select one of the following values in minutes. For sharded cluster instances, the valid values are 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 360, 480, and 720. For replica set instances, the valid values are 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 360, 480, and 720.

<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to DELETE. Geo-redundancy backup policies support only dayOfWeek.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
备份周期
当BackupPolicy=dayOfWeek :  1,2,3,4,5,6,7  表示周一到周五，一周至少备份2次。
当BackupPolicy=dayOfMonth：1,3,-1 表示每月1、3和最后一天。  -1 表示每月最后一天  。
当BackupPolicy=dayOfYear ： 01-07 表示1月7日 ，只能选一天。
当BackupPolicy=backupInterval：取下列数字中的一个，单位min。 其中，分片集群选择范围为30,60,120,180,240,360,480,720，副本集选择范围为15,30,60,120,180,240, 360,480,720。

注意：

<notice>ActionType!=delete时必填，
异地备份策略只支持dayOfWeek。></notice>
fields.name: preferred_backup_period

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable hourly sparse backup.

true: When the backup frequency is at the minute level, all snapshots within 1 hour from the current time are retained. For snapshots that are more than 1 hour but within 24 hours from the current time, only the first snapshot after each hour is retained.

false: All snapshots within the high-frequency backup retention period are retained
fields.help_zh:
是否开启按小时稀疏备份。

true：当备份频率为分钟级时，距离当前时间1小时内的快照全部保留。距离当前时间超过1小时且在24小时内的快照，仅保留整点后的第一个快照。

false：高频备份保留天数内的快照全部保留
fields.name: preserve_one_each_hour

fields.help_en:
The number of days to retain the backup plan.
Same-region backup: 7 to 7300 days.
Geo-redundancy backup: 3 to 1825 days.
<notice>This parameter is required when RetentionType is set to delay.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
备份计划保留天数。
同地域备份： 7-7300天。
跨异地备份： 3-1825 天。
<notice> 当RetentionType 为delay时必填。></notice>
fields.name: retention_period

fields.help_en:
The retention period type of the backup set.

never: Long-term retention (LTR).
delay: Retention for a fixed number of days.
<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to DELETE.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
备份集保留周期类型

never：长期保留
delay：固定天数保留
<notice>ActionType!=delete时必填></notice>
fields.name: retention_type

fields.help_en:
The region where the instance resides.

<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to DELETE.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
实例所在地域。

<notice>ActionType!=delete时必填></notice>
fields.name: src_region

fields.help_en:
The source type of the backup policy.
  
db: same-region backup.
level1: cross-region backup.
<notice>This parameter is required when ActionType is not set to DELETE.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
备份策略源类型。
  
db： 同地域备份
level1 ： 跨地域备份
<notice>ActionType!=delete时必填></notice>
fields.name: src_type

The action type.
CREATE: Create.
UPDATE: Update.
<notice>This parameter applies only to geo-redundancy backup. To delete geo-redundancy backup, use UPDATE with EnableLogBackup set to 0.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
操作类型
CREATE：创建
UPDATE：修改
<notice>只针对异地备份生效，删除异地备份时，使用update enablelogbackup=0的方式。></notice>
fields.name: action_type

fields.help_en:
The region where the geo-redundancy log backup resides.


This parameter is required for geo-redundancy backup
fields.help_zh:
异地日志备份所在地域。


异地备份必填
fields.name: dest_region

fields.help_en:
The destination type of the log backup policy.
 
level1: same-region backup. 
level2Cross: cross-region backup
fields.help_zh:
日志备份策略目标类型。
 
level1 ：同地域备份 
level2Cross：跨地域备份
fields.name: dest_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup.

1: Enabled.
0: Disabled.



Log backup must be enabled for sharded cluster instances.
Cross-region log backup requires same-region log backup to be enabled first
fields.help_zh:
是否开启日志备份：

1：开启
0：未开启



分片实例必须开启日志备份。
打开异地日志备份必须先打开同地域日志备份
fields.name: enable_log_backup

fields.help_en: The log backup policy ID. This parameter exists only for cross-region log backup policies and is required
fields.help_zh: 日志备份策略 id，只有异地日志备份策略存在且必填
fields.name: policy_id

fields.help_en:
The number of days to retain log backups. This parameter takes effect when RetentionType is set to delay.

Same-region backup: 7 to 7300 days. 
Geo-redundancy backup: 3 to 1825 days. The value must be less than the backup retention period of the geo-redundancy backup policy
fields.help_zh:
日志备份保留天数, 当RetentionType 为delay时生效。

同地域备份：7-7300天 
跨异地备份：3-1825 天 ，且需要小于异地备份策略的备份保留时间
fields.name: retention_period

fields.help_en:
The retention period type of the log backup.

never: Long-term retention (LTR).
delay: Retention for a fixed number of days
fields.help_zh:
日志备份保留周期类型：

never：长期保留
delay：固定天数保留
fields.name: retention_type

fields.help_en: The region where the source instance resides
fields.help_zh: 源实例所在区域
fields.name: src_region

fields.help_en:
The source type of the log backup policy.
  
db: same-region backup.
level1: cross-region backup

日志备份策略源类型。
  
db： 同地域备份
level1 ： 跨地域备份
